name: Unity
oneLiner: UTY is XSY's delta-neutral synthetic dollar on Avalanche: USDC deposits hedged by long AVAX spot and short perps, with a 7-day redemption unbonding.
collateral: USDC deposits hedged via delta-neutral pairing of long AVAX spot positions with short perpetual futures; yield generated from perpetual contract funding rates; custody via Ceffu & Copper Clearloop
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDC to mint UTY at 1:1; XSY maintains peg by delta-neutral hedging with long AVAX spot and short perpetual futures positions; users redeem UTY back to USDC after a 7-day unbonding period

oracleRisk.summary: UTY's documented Base mint path deposits USDC 1:1 and sweeps the backing to a custodian-managed strategy. XSY discloses exchange-level liquidation risk for managed short hedges, but public sources do not identify the strategy price-feed topology, freshness bounds, or fallback controls.

branchApplicability.rationale: YieldPoint documents one Base hub vault: users deposit USDC to mint UTY, backing is swept to a custodian, and redemption uses an asynchronous withdrawal queue. XSY describes protocol-managed strategy modules rather than borrower-owned debt positions. Therefore per-collateral oracle and liquidation branches do not apply; exchange liquidation of managed hedges remains strategy risk.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: UTY moves cross-chain via LayerZero's OFT standard in a hub-and-spoke design: Base is the hub holding the canonical UTY/yUTY ERC-7540 vault token, where a ShareOFTAdapter lockbox LOCKS tokens sent cross-chain (not burned); Avalanche and Katana are spoke chains where UTY is a mint/burn OFT against the locked hub balance. Each pathway is verified by at least 2 independent LayerZero DVNs (Base-Avalanche: LayerZero Labs + Google Cloud; Base-Katana: LayerZero Labs + Nethermind). On-chain confirmed: Base 0xBA515304... is the ERC4626/7540 vault; Avalanche 0xBA515304... (same CREATE2 address) is a LayerZero OFT spoke. Note: the registry's older Avalanche address 0xdbc5192a... is a separate legacy native-mint deployment, distinct from the live OFT spoke.

protocols.name: LayerZero (OFT Adapter lockbox on Base hub + mint/burn spoke OFTs)
protocols.note: Base ShareOFTAdapter locks the canonical UTY vault token; Avalanche/Katana spoke OFTs mint/burn. Threshold of >=2 independent DVNs per pathway (Base-Avalanche: LayerZero Labs + Google Cloud; Base-Katana: LayerZero Labs + Nethermind).

mintAuthority.summary: The tracked UTY deployment mints collateralized vault shares from USDC on Base and uses LayerZero OFTs on Avalanche and Katana. All three UTY contracts are UUPS proxies owned without delay by the same EOA; Base's mutable maxTotalAssets cap is currently uint256 max and can be changed independently by any of three EOA MANAGER_ROLE members.

review.evidence: The prior record described legacy Avalanche token 0xdbc5192a..., which is not the address tracked in the deployment registry. Live RPC review of the tracked 0xba515304... address found three distinct UUPS implementations with the same EOA owner on Base, Avalanche, and Katana. Verified Base source established the collateralized mint path, mutable cap, enumerable manager set, and owner-only upgrade path; project docs establish Base as the vault hub and Avalanche/Katana as OFT spokes.
